Hello everyone,

In a week a lot has changed here. I'm mostly talking about Voat, but also about the refactoring of AVE.

I had planned to finish AVE v2 a bit sooner, sorry for the delay. Also, this is version 2, but consider AVE in beta as long as Voat is in Beta too.

So, what's new?

Now, all modules are completely independent and the creation of new features will be way easier.

Preference Manager:

The preference Manager is completely new, you will now acces AVE's settings from the "AVE" link next to the cog at the top right of the screen. All modules can be deactivated from there, this is also where you will find more information and the option to customize features.

Usertagging:

I've been teasing this a bit these past days. This is essentially what RES implemented, meaning that when tagging a user you can also choose a custom colour for the tag's background. You can see in the picture "Ignore", this is for a feature that is not yet implemented.

Vote Balance:

This features displays next to usernames the vote balance: how many times you have upvoted someone's submissions minus how many times you have downvoted them.

Toggle Child Comment:

A link, titled "Hide child comments", is inserted into each comment having at least a child comment of its own. This link will show or hide all of them.

BackCompatibility module:

This module was created to migrate data from the first version to the second: your custom list of subverses/sets and your usertags.

I added some fixes too, you can read the entire changelog by clicking on the version number in the preference Manager.

Chrome:

There is no chrome version anymore, the userscript now work with firefox and chrome.

If you want to migrate your old data in Chrome, you shouldn't install AVE v2. You need to manually replace the old userscript with the new, in TamperMonkey's dashboard (click "AVE for chrome").

Bugs:

I have been testing and debugging alone, and as far as I know there are no bugs left. But, I am sure you will unfortunately find new ones, and I'm sorry for that. If you report them in this thread or on github, I will do my best to find fixes quickly.
